description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC controller, FilesController, which handles HTTP requests for serving static files and product files in an e-commerce application. It includes methods for downloading files by store code and filename, with security annotations for role-based access control. The controller leverages a ContentService to retrieve file contents and manages HTTP responses including error handling.

classes.name: FilesController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller class for handling HTTP requests related to serving static and product files in an e-commerce web application.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to serve static files based on store code, filename, and extension; retrieves the file content via ContentService and writes it to the response.

methods.name: downloadProduct
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to serve product digital files with access restricted to roles 'admin', 'superadmin', or 'product'; retrieves the file and sets appropriate response headers for download.
